title: Learning is empty when Maya is still loved
summary: Religious learning stays hollow while attachment still rules the heart. Receive the gift without claiming the outcome.
takeaway: Receive the gift without claiming the outcome.
lifeApplication: Before grasping harder, pause with one hand open and let refuge matter more than possession.

source.shortMeaning: Religious learning stays hollow while attachment still rules the heart.
source.lifeApplication: Before teaching the line, ask what attachment in you still refuses it.

evidence.coreClaim: Religious learning stays hollow while attachment still rules the heart.
evidence.turn: Knowledge without inward freedom still serves attachment.
evidence.practicalImplication: Before grasping harder, pause with one hand open and let refuge matter more than possession.
